title: Chrysanthemum Tea

seo.title: Chrysanthemum Tea Recipe: Easy & Authentic Chinese Drink
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make refreshing Chrysanthemum Tea at home with our easy, authentic Chinese recipe. Discover the benefits and enjoy this traditional beverage today!

seo.imageAlt: A steaming cup of authentic Chrysanthemum Tea with dried chrysanthemum flowers and honey
seo.imageCaption: Enjoy a soothing cup of homemade Chrysanthemum Tea, a traditional Chinese beverage known for its delicate flavor and health benefits.

description: Chrysanthemum Tea is a beloved traditional Chinese floral infusion, cherished for its delicate aroma and refreshing, slightly sweet taste. This soothing beverage is often enjoyed for its cooling properties and numerous health benefits, making it a perfect drink for any time of day. Preparing it at home allows you to savor its authentic essence and customize its sweetness to your liking.

ingredients.notes: optional, for added flavor and health benefits

instructions.title: Rinse Chrysanthemum Flowers
instructions.text: Gently rinse the dried chrysanthemum flowers under cold running water in a fine-mesh sieve for about 10-15 seconds to remove any dust or impurities. Drain well.

instructions.title: Prepare Boiling Water
instructions.text: In a medium saucepan or a kettle, bring 4 cups of filtered water to a rolling boil.

instructions.title: Infuse Flowers
instructions.text: Carefully add the rinsed chrysanthemum flowers and optional goji berries into a heatproof teapot or a large mug.

instructions.title: Pour Hot Water
instructions.text: Pour the freshly boiled water over the chrysanthemum flowers and goji berries in the teapot or mug.

instructions.title: Steep the Tea
instructions.text: Cover the teapot or mug with a lid and let the tea steep for 3-5 minutes. For a stronger flavor, you can steep it for a little longer, up to 7 minutes.

instructions.title: Sweeten and Serve
instructions.text: Strain the tea into serving cups, discarding the flowers if desired. Add rock sugar or honey to taste, stirring until dissolved. Serve hot or chilled.

instructions.title: Optional Re-steeping
instructions.text: The chrysanthemum flowers can often be re-steeped once or twice. Just add more hot water and steep for a slightly longer time, approximately 5-7 minutes.

tips: For the best flavor, always use high-quality dried chrysanthemum flowers, preferably those labeled Hangzhou white chrysanthemum (杭白菊) or Huangshan Gongju (黄山贡菊).
Adjust the amount of rock sugar or honey to your preference. For a truly authentic experience, some prefer it unsweetened to fully appreciate the floral notes.
Chrysanthemum tea can be enjoyed hot or chilled. If serving cold, let it cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 2-3 hours. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 days.
